name: e7_factor_oracle
description: Do neutralization and a factor risk model help when forecast errors are factor bets? Factor-structured oracles (factor_forecast, three principal-component factors) at IC 0.03 with 0, 30% and 60% of error variance from the factors, two seeds; beta neutralization on or off, shrunk-sample or factor risk model, signal and HRP books held for the horizon. With iid errors (share 0) these transforms can only remove signal. About 6 tasks of 16 configurations: roughly 10 minutes.
